depicted_variant: Burung Taiheiki berwajah manusia, paruh bergigi gergaji, tubuh ular, dua sayap dan dua kaki bercakar tajam, berseru di atas Shishinden.

visual_requirements.description: Satu kepala berwajah manusia dan paruh melengkung bergigi gergaji; tubuh ular, dua kaki dengan taji tajam, dua sayap rentang sekitar4,8m.
Ketika berseru seperti menyemburkan nyala dari mulut dan kilat dari suara.
Di langit malam atas Shishinden pada musim gugur.

aura: Keanehan anatomi c10 dan nyala/kilat dalam seruan c11 membuatnya berbahaya (klaim: itsumade-c11).
artistic_choices: Nyala singkat dan satu kilat lokal dari seruan diterapkan sesuai teks, tanpa amplop aura.
Kamera rendah dari atap istana memberi ukuran lewat genteng kecil, rentang sayap sekitar4,8m.
Burung monster tanpa bangkai atau korban; palet walnut dan tembaga.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of ITSUMADE, the eerie bird described in the Taiheiki.
ANATOMY: exactly ONE head with a HUMAN-LIKE face merged with a strongly curved forward BEAK lined with SAW-LIKE TEETH, TWO eyes; long SNAKE-shaped body; exactly TWO broad bird wings spanning about 4.8 metres, TWO feet with long sword-sharp spurs. No extra heads, no human arms. [itsumade-c10]
MOMENT: swooping down toward the viewer while crying fiercely, wings thrown wide above a palace roof, serpentine body curling behind, two clawed feet thrust forward.
POWER: its cry seems to spit a SHORT flame from the mouth, a single fork of lightning flashing immediately within the cry; these cast sharp light across the palace roof. No energy halo, no runes. [itsumade-c11]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle looking from close palace eaves, bird fills the square, small roof tiles show its documented large wingspan.
LIGHT & WEATHER: flame from mouth is the dominant amber light with sharp dark shadows, faint autumn rain, no daylight.
SURFACE: coarse dark feathers, reptilian textured body, hard hooked beak and teeth, ancient roof tiles.
SETTING: night sky directly above Shishinden during autumn. [itsumade-c09]
MOOD: dangerous and imposing, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: square at least 1024px; no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: PNG asli dilihat: satu wajah mirip manusia dengan paruh melengkung dan gigi gergaji, tubuh panjang bersisik melingkar, dua sayap dan dua kaki bertaji tajam. Serbuan di atas Shishinden, nyala dan kilat lokal dari seruan c11. Subjek mendominasi dan masih mengancam pada thumbnail; semua tujuh Uji Sangar ya. Tidak ada teks/gore/atribut adaptasi. Kontak thumbnail asli berukuran200 piksel dilihat ulang bersama13 PNG lane-A; ciri subjek dan kesan sangar/agung tetap terbaca.

root_visual_review.notes: Human-faced bird with a saw-toothed hooked beak, serpent body, two wings and two taloned feet crying out with flame and lightning above the palace roof at night, autumn leaves.
